fields.title: ZPPA tender record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Record shape depends on 'mode': 'list' rows come from ZPPA's paginated 'Opened Bid Details' table (list-level fields only); 'latest' rows come from the homepage's currently-open tenders, each enriched with the full detail page; 'detail' rows are a single on-demand tender lookup. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: 'latest' / 'list' for those modes, or the exact resourceId/URL requested in 'detail' mode.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-opened-tenders-html, S1-latest-widget-html, S1-detail-html, or 'none' on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed/degraded records: http_<code>, unexpected_shape, blocked_or_transient, invalid_input, or login_required (expected once a tender's bid submission deadline has passed -- see README).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

resourceId.title: Tender resource ID
resourceId.description: ZPPA's internal numeric tender identifier, used to build the detail page URL.

position.title: Row position
position.description: (list mode) 1-10 position within its result page (not a stable global rank).

tenderTitle.title: Tender title
tenderTitle.description: (list mode) Tender title, from the 'Tender Title' column.

title.title: Tender title
title.description: (latest/detail mode) Tender title, from the widget/detail page heading.

referenceNumber.title: Reference number
referenceNumber.description: (list mode) ZPPA's tender reference number, from the 'Reference number' column, e.g. '23698/2/521/2026'.

pe.title: Procuring entity
pe.description: (list mode) The government body/parastatal running this tender, from the 'PE' column.

bidsSubmissionDeadline.title: Bid submission deadline
bidsSubmissionDeadline.description: (list mode) Raw deadline string as shown on the site, e.g. 'Wed Aug 26 16:00:00 CAT 2026'.

procurementMethod.title: Procurement method
procurementMethod.description: (list mode) e.g. 'Direct Bidding', 'Simplified Bidding', 'Open Bidding National'.

openedBids.title: Opened bids label
openedBids.description: (list mode) Raw text of the 'Opened Bids' column link, usually 'View Opened Bids'.

openedBidsUrl.title: Opened bids URL
openedBidsUrl.description: (list mode) Link to the bid-opening detail page for this tender (may itself require a ZPPA account login to view).

awardDate.title: Award date
awardDate.description: (list mode) Contract award date, when already awarded; often blank while a tender is still in evaluation.

detailUrl.title: Detail page URL
detailUrl.description: Full URL of this tender's detail page on eprocure.zppa.org.zm.

publishedDateParts.title: Published date parts
publishedDateParts.description: (latest mode) [day, month-abbrev, 2-digit-year] as displayed on the homepage widget, e.g. ['26','Aug','26'].

detail.title: Full tender detail
detail.description: (latest mode) The enriched detail-page object (title/fields/rawFields/procuringEntityUrl) for this tender, present only when the detail page was accessible (see detailError otherwise).

detailError.title: Detail fetch error
detailError.description: (latest mode) Set instead of 'detail' when the detail page could not be fetched, e.g. 'login_required'.

fields.title: Detail fields
fields.description: (latest/detail mode) All tender detail-page fields as a flat object, keyed by a camelCase version of the site's own field label (e.g. 'nameOfProcuringEntity', 'deadlineForBidSubmission', 'paymentAmountZmw'). Field set varies by tender type -- this is not a fixed schema.

rawFields.title: Detail fields (raw label/value pairs)
rawFields.description: (latest/detail mode) The same detail-page fields as an ordered array of {label, value}, preserving the exact on-site label text verbatim.

procuringEntityUrl.title: Procuring entity URL
procuringEntityUrl.description: (latest/detail mode) Link to the procuring entity's organisation page on the e-GP portal, when the detail page links one.
